page.content:
Peter Parker's web-slinging Marvel hero.

How Spider-Man connects

  • Creator: Steve Ditko — Steve Ditko co-created Spider-Man.
  • Creator: Stan Lee — Stan Lee co-created Spider-Man.
  • Location: New York City — Spider-Man protects New York City.
  • Faction: Avengers — Spider-Man has served with the Avengers.

What is Spider-Man?

Spider-Man is Peter Parker's alter ego, a New York City hero tied to Stan Lee and Steve Ditko's creation and often allied with the Avengers.

Key threads lead to Steve Ditko, Stan Lee, New York City and Avengers.
